goal: iPhone 4S (A5) running iOS 6.1.3 at the speed of the real phone, on Windows, then Android

items.name: Toolchain and Windows build
items.note: MSYS2 UCRT64, QEMU 11.0.3 links; MinGW fixes upstreamable

items.name: Firmware preparation (ios-prep)
items.note: IPSW to kboot, rootfs, PPN NAND store, the install boot's two helpers (static and dyld-linked) and ramdisk; boot logo pending

items.name: Boot to launchd (userland)
items.note: M2: BSD root disk0s1 from the NAND, launchd and the daemons; keybagd runs with the system keybag (B4); SpringBoard waits in BKSDisplayServicesStart on backboardd (M3)

items.name: Storage: IOP, PPN NAND, FTL, NVRAM
items.note: FTL formats and opens, IONVRAM up, system volume as marker pages (B3), effaceable storage formatted (B4); FTL speed and wear open

items.name: Persistence (data volume, NVRAM across boots)
items.note: data volume, NVRAM generations, FTL state, effaceable lockers and the system keybag survive boots; sealing open

items.name: Cortex-A9 core, TCG
items.note: one core boots; second core, IPIs and SMP bring-up pending

items.name: Apple AIC and timers
items.note: vectors, masks, per-CPU timer FIQ; IPI and cpu1 timer open

items.name: PMGR clocks, GPIO, DWI, watchdog, PL310
items.note: A4 models at A5 addresses; the A5 clock table is still the A4 map

items.name: PMU D1881, I2C, sensors
items.note: events, ADC, RTC, restart; ADC channels, wake events, gyro/accel calibration open

items.name: DMA (CDMA) and crypto (AES, SHA, PKE)
items.note: CDMA + AES filter from the A4; SHA-2 block new, untouched by the kernel so far

items.name: USB (OTG device, EHCI/OHCI, HSIC)
items.note: blocks wired, OTG enumerates endpoints; usbmux/AFC and HSIC devices pending

items.name: Display pipe + CLCD + MIPI-DSI, 640x960 panel
items.note: AppleCLCD adopts the framebuffer, backboardd's software CA swaps through the A5 layer MMU: boot overlay on screen; app frames wait on audio (M3)

items.name: GPU: GL bridge on Windows (ANGLE)
items.note: the fork's host executor is macOS-only; an EGL/ANGLE backend is new work

items.name: Multitouch (SPI) and buttons
items.note: A4 digitizer models to adapt; n94 profile unknown

items.name: Audio (I2S, CS42L63, AE2)
items.note: ae2 hidden; mediaserverd's audio session never starts and gates backboardd and SpringBoard (M3): the AE2 IOP is next

items.name: Wi-Fi over HSIC, Bluetooth, baseband
items.note: baseband unmatched, HSIC ports time out cleanly; stubs for M4

items.name: Speed: 1:1 with a real 4S on PC
items.note: MTTCG, WFI, profiling; measured after M3
